course.title: PyTorch — From Beginner to Professional Practice
course.description: A visual-first, project-based course covering tensors, autograd, neural networks, data pipelines, training, evaluation, vision, NLP, model persistence, GPU computing, performance, distributed training, export, deployment, testing, security, and professional workflows.
course.version_scope: Checked 2026-10-20 against the current official PyTorch documentation surfaced for this run (2.14 documentation), with TorchVision, torchao, TorchRL, TorchAudio, and TorchCodec version scopes treated independently. Installation commands and hardware/package compatibility must be chosen with the official installation selector.
prerequisites: Python fundamentals: variables, functions, classes, modules, and exceptions.
Basic array manipulation and introductory linear algebra, derivatives, probability, and statistics.
Command-line familiarity is useful for setup and professional workflows.
learning_outcomes: Create and manipulate tensors with explicit shape, dtype, device, and memory-layout reasoning.
Build datasets, neural-network modules, training loops, checkpoints, and evaluation pipelines.
Compare model quality using appropriate metrics, data splits, and error analysis.
Use vision, NLP, generative-model, accelerator, compiler, distributed, and export workflows where relevant.
Test and document maintainable, secure, reproducible model artifacts and inference interfaces.

source_pdf.review_notes: All 43 pages were text-extracted and rendered; page contact sheets were inspected, including practical exercise tables and project/capstone visuals on pages 33-38.

pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.pdf_treatment: Use the official installation selector as the source of truth.
pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.implementation: No single CUDA/ROCm/Python command is hardcoded as universal; confirm compatibility for each learner.
The lessons distinguish the established FullyShardedDataParallel API from newer FSDP2 fully_shard guidance; learners should select and validate the supported workflow for their target release.

pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.pdf_treatment: Covers TorchAudio, TorchCodec, and audio/video data.
pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.implementation: Current official package guidance is linked and versioned separately; TorchCodec is included for codec-oriented I/O rather than assuming all historical TorchAudio interfaces are current.

pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.pdf_treatment: Covers quantization-aware training and modern torchao workflows.
pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.implementation: torchao is presented as versioned specialist material; configuration availability and speed depend on supported hardware and package versions.
Explicitly prefer state dictionaries, trusted artifacts, restricted loading where supported, and never load untrusted serialized objects.

pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.pdf_treatment: Provides a comprehensive proposed curriculum and assessment plan.
pdf_corrections_and_scope_notes.implementation: All generated course items remain draft pending subject-matter review and actual execution of examples; publishing is deliberately not enabled.

course.status_note: Draft content only. Static validation and representative snippet checks do not constitute full subject-matter review or hardware-specific execution of every lesson.
